## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Adaptation** — A trait that helps an organism survive in its environment
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Parasitic plant** — A plant that feeds on another plant
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Carnivorous plant** — A plant that traps and digests animals for nutrients
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Epiphyte** — A plant that grows on another plant without harming it
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Dormancy** — A state of reduced growth when conditions are unfavorable
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Pollination** — The transfer of pollen from one flower to another
:::
